verdict.rationale: The docs describe the pieces of this story. Work mode can 'search the web, browse websites, compare sources… and summarize findings' and carry a larger task to a reviewable result, web search shows citations in chat, and Work can turn research into a report or document. However, no dedicated deep-research mode is documented, so the story is delivered only by combining these features. Missing for 10: a named deep-research feature, evidence that citations carry into the finished report, documentation of how many sources it covers autonomously, and independent hands-on corroboration of research-report quality.
